title: Act: Add the shadcn-style Dialog wrapper
acceptance_criteria: dialog.tsx exports Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose
DialogContent renders overlay and content in a Portal and merges className with cn

steps.symbol: new: Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription
steps.action: Create the file importing * as DialogPrimitive from @radix-ui/react-dialog and cn from ../../lib/utils. Export Dialog = DialogPrimitive.Root and DialogClose = DialogPrimitive.Close. Add forwardRef DialogContent that renders DialogPrimitive.Portal containing DialogPrimitive.Overlay (fixed inset-0 bg-black/60) and DialogPrimitive.Content with cn base classes and the className prop. Add forwardRef DialogTitle and DialogDescription over DialogPrimitive.Title and DialogPrimitive.Description, and DialogHeader as a div.
steps.code: export const DialogContent = forwardRef<ElementRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>, ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content>>(function DialogContent({ className, children, ...props }, ref) { return (<DialogPrimitive.Portal><DialogPrimitive.Overlay className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60" /><DialogPrimitive.Content ref={ref} className={cn('fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2', className)} {...props}>{children}</DialogPrimitive.Content></DialogPrimitive.Portal>); });
steps.expected: Module exports the six named parts and type-checks
